user_problem: A knowledge collection needs consistent labels separating quotation, paraphrase, observation, assumption, and synthesis.
unique_output: A labeling specification with definitions, required metadata, decision rules, edge cases, and labeled synthetic examples.
required_input: Allowed label set, source metadata requirements, supplied edge cases, and rules for mixed-content notes.
critical_rule: A label describes provenance form, not truth; mixed notes must be split or explicitly carry multiple labels.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is decision-evidence-ledger; this standardizes provenance labels across knowledge notes rather than classifying decision records.
acceptance_scenario: Input labels Quote, Paraphrase, Observation, Assumption; note contains a copied sentence plus analyst inference. Output splits it into Quote with source and Assumption with author, without marking either verified.
